title: Four more former Crimean prosecutors sentenced for treason
summary: Four former prosecutors from Crimea – a former deputy prosecutor of Kerch, a senior prosecutor from the Bakhchysarai District Prosecutor's Office, and two former prosecutors from the Prosecutor's Office of the Autonomous Republic of Crimea – have been sentenced in absentia for high treason.

title: Extortionists suspected of demanding $1M arrested in Mykolaiv region
summary: The Security Service of Ukraine (SBU), jointly with the National Police, has exposed a criminal group whose members are suspected of demanding $1 million from a businessman over a fictitious debt.

title: SBU exposes 109 criminal groups undermining stability in Ukraine this year
summary: Since the beginning of the year, units of the Security Service of Ukraine's (SBU) Main Directorate D have exposed 109 criminal organizations and groups involved in undermining domestic stability and notified 3,920 individuals of suspicion.

title: Russian drone strikes residential building in Kropyvnytskyi, three injured
summary: A Russian drone has struck a residential building in Kropyvnytskyi.

title: Russian attack on Chornomorsk leaves six injured, damages energy infrastructure
summary: Six people were injured in a Russian attack on the city of Chornomorsk in the Odesa region. Energy infrastructure and an administrative building were also damaged.

title: Russian forces strike energy infrastructure in Zhytomyr region
summary: Russian attacks have damaged energy infrastructure and residential buildings in the Zhytomyr region.

title: Russian attacks leave 14 injured in Kharkiv region, damage businesses, warehouses, and homes
summary: Fourteen people, including four children, were injured in Russian attacks in the Kharkiv region over the past day.

title: Petrochemical plant on fire in Tatarstan following drone attack, substation damaged in Taganrog – media
summary: A fire broke out at the Nizhnekamskneftekhim industrial facility in Russia's Tatarstan region following a nighttime drone attack, while an electrical substation supplying power to Taganrog's industrial zone in the Rostov region was damaged.

title: War update: 171 combat engagements on front line over past day
summary: On November 14, Ukraine's Defense Forces engaged Russian troops in 171 combat clashes along the front line.

title: Russian forces attack industrial facility in Kirovohrad region, causing fires
summary: Russian forces attacked an industrial infrastructure facility in the Kirovohrad region, causing fires to break out.

title: Air defense neutralizes 106 of 132 Russian drones used to attack Ukraine
summary: Air defense forces neutralized 106 drones used by the Russian military to attack Ukraine overnight on November 15.

title: Private house catches fire following enemy attack in Dnipro district
summary: A private house caught fire in Dnipro district following a drone attack.

title: Russians shell Dnipropetrovsk region more than 10 times since evening, damaging homes, transport infrastructure
summary: Russian forces attacked four districts of the Dnipropetrovsk region more than 10 times since the evening, damaging residential buildings, a store, and transport infrastructure.

title: Russian army loses another 2,230 soldiers in war against Ukraine over past day
summary: The total estimated combat losses of Russian military personnel from February 24, 2022, to November 15, 2026, have reached approximately 1,622,860, including 2,230 troops lost by the enemy over the past 24 hours.

title: Israel strikes Hamas military wing, killing senior commander
summary: Israel has carried out a strike against Hamas's military wing, killing a senior commander and injuring several other people.

title: Russians strike Zaporizhzhia eight times, injuring five people, including an elderly woman
summary: Russian forces carried out eight strikes on Zaporizhzhia, injuring five people, including an elderly woman. A fire broke out in an apartment building.

title: Program to relocate cultural workers from Russian regions to so-called LPR fails – Regional Administration
summary: A program intended to relocate cultural workers from Russian regions to the so-called "Luhansk People's Republic" (LPR) has proven ineffective.

title: Prince Harry visits Lviv for first Superhumans War Trauma Conference
summary: Prince Harry visited Lviv and took part in the first international Superhumans War Trauma Conference. The event took place on November 13–14, 2026, at the All-Ukrainian War Trauma Center.

title: Russia can not determine Europe's security architecture – Carney
summary: Only European countries and NATO, not Russia, will decide what Europe's security architecture will look like.

title: Svitolina defeats Czech player Noskova to reach WTA tournament final
summary: Elina Svitolina and "neutral" player Mirra Andreeva will face each other in the WTA tournament final.

title: US identifies cause of major outage that paralyzed air travel
summary: A major outage in the US air traffic control system occurred during an upgrade of its communications network. Work to replace copper cable with fiber-optic cable caused a router malfunction, which overloaded part of the data transmission system connecting air traffic controllers and aircraft.

title: Ukrainian embassy calls vandalism of Warsaw ghetto heroes monument act of Russia’s hybrid warfare
summary: The Embassy of Ukraine in Poland has condemned an act of vandalism targeting the Ghetto Heroes Monument in Warsaw, describing the inscription “Slava UPA,” painted on the monument by unknown perpetrators, as an act of Russia’s hybrid warfare aimed at inciting hostility between Ukrainians and Poles.

title: Lubinets, Russian ombudswoman discuss mechanism for large-scale prisoner exchange
summary: Ukraine’s Parliamentary Commissioner for Human Rights, Dmytro Lubinets, has discussed mechanisms for implementing a future prisoner exchange with Russian ombudswoman Yana Lantratova and received confirmation that it would involve at least 1,000 people.
